name: 严岛神社本社临海社殿与回廊
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu colored companion heritage plate. Image 1 is the EXACT final black ink line plate of jp_itsukushima; preserve its silhouette, framing, roof count, openings, architectural details and all major contours. Image 2 is a documentary photograph of this same Japanese monument for ACTUAL material colors. Image 3 is the project's matte colored architectural illustration style sample ONLY; its black background and warm gold palette are NOT to be copied. Color Image 1 faithfully as an elegant museum architectural illustration. Material observations: Vermilion-orange lacquered posts and open corridors, pale off-white wall panels, charcoal-gray Japanese roof tiles, deep brown timber understructure and only a few narrow muted blue-gray waterline strokes. Preserve large white blank areas around the architecture. Keep thin charcoal ink contours visible, with restrained matte mineral pigment planes and only very light texture INSIDE solid building surfaces. Do not add features, people, trees, labels or neighboring structures. Retain Image 1's composition and aspect ratio. Entire exterior background and truly open spaces must be perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF with no black ground, gray haze, gradient, paper texture, shadow, glow, checkerboard or transparency. This is colorization, not redesign.
material_observations: 朱红柱梁、浅色墙板、深灰屋顶、海水的少量淡蓝线条。

technical_review.note: 已查看原稿与实拍材料色；不等于用户视觉验收。宽幅社殿群作现状意写；不同社殿不共享单一建年。
